title: Agent Runtime Design Notes
snippet: A minimal agent runtime should separate the loop, tool registry, context builder, and persistence so each part can be tested independently.

title: Context Compression Playbook
snippet: Use a structured summary plus a recent-message window. Keep raw history in storage, but do not inject all old turns into the model prompt.

title: Tool Safety Checklist
snippet: Tools need schemas, argument validation, timeouts, error wrapping, trace events, and allow-list lookup from the registry.

title: Session Isolation
snippet: Chat history and summaries are scoped by user_id and session_id. Business data can be user scoped when the product semantics require it.
